note: D-031: the gate classifies a worker's decision_required / blocked / clarification_required into one decision class of authority.json and scores confidence; the accountable role still writes the decision. `gate` selects the implementation: `fake` (deterministic keyword table below, for P2) or `jev` (TypeSafe Jev over POST /v1/systemone with TYPESAFE_API_KEY, P3). Below `threshold` the question escalates to the CEO through the origin conversation. An unavailable gate escalates the same way.

approval.note: D-033. `ceo_only` patterns are matched in plain code BEFORE any model is asked; a hit always escalates to the CEO. `routine` names the actions Jev may approve alone (one typed Choice over these plus `not_routine`); a confident routine match resumes the worker at once with an approval. Patterns are lowercase substrings.

routine.branch_or_commit: create or switch a working branch, or commit on the current working branch
routine.run_checks: run tests, lint, format or analyze
routine.install_locked_package: install a package that is already in the lock file
routine.read_only_query: a read-only query of the database, Jira or git history
routine.jira_comment: post a findings comment on a Jira ticket
routine.file_followup_backlog: file a follow-up ticket in Backlog
routine.own_execution_status: move its own ticket into its own execution status
routine.open_pull_request: open a pull request (not merge it)
routine.retry_once: retry a failed test or a failed delivery once
routine.resume_worker: resume the same worker with an answer
routine.option_within_criteria: choose between options the acceptance criteria already allow
routine.release_worktree: release a finished worktree or clean its own temp files
routine.not_routine: none of the above: a question, a judgement, or an action not listed

jev_provider.note: CEO chose OpenRouter 2026-10-01 (no waitlist; same /v1/systemone body as direct). To switch route edit this block only: direct = https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, model jev-latest, key_env TYPESAFE_API_KEY; Vercel = https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/typesafe/v1/systemone with an AI Gateway key.
